purpose: Private exploratory evaluation of incremental lunar phase information alongside technical analysis; no public forecast or trading policy.

data.licensing: Private research only. Public display/redistribution rights have not been established. Raw vendor data is stored outside the checkout.

target.name: next_utc_daily_close_direction
target.cutoff: Opening time of bar t plus 86400 seconds, when its close is finalized.
target.tie: A zero return belongs to class 0.
target.missing: No filling. Require 61 consecutive daily bars through t and one complete next bar for the target.

features.lunarConvention: Pinned @zodiacs/engine moonPhase at the forecast cutoff; Moon-minus-Sun geocentric ecliptic elongation. New/full flags use circular angular distance <=12 degrees. Flags are phase proximity, not exact event times.
features.scope: Lunar features only. No feature selection, no slow-planet aspects, no natal features, no magnitude or profitability analysis.

split.purge: Training targetEnd must be strictly earlier than the next evaluation start. Validation labels ending at or after testStart are excluded. This removes boundary label overlaps.
split.scaling: Mean and population standard deviation fit on training rows only, independently per asset/fold/model. Constant scales use 1.

model.objective: Mean binary log loss + lambda/2 * sum(non-intercept weights squared)
model.selection: Lowest sample-weighted validation log loss across the two expanding chronological folds. Exact ties favor higher regularization. Features and candidates freeze before final holdout evaluation.
model.optimizer: Damped Newton, at most 60 iterations, gradient tolerance 1e-8
benchmarks: Training-only smoothed P(next direction | current direction), Beta(1,1) smoothing

evaluation.primaryComparison: Combined minus TA-only final holdout Brier score; negative is improvement.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of per-day score differences, block length 30 days, 1000 replicates, seeded PRNG. Report central 95% intervals and conservative 97.5% intervals for the two asset comparisons.
evaluation.secondary: Combined minus TA-only log loss interval and astro-only/baseline scores are exploratory.
evaluation.independence: Days and lunar observations are temporally dependent. BTC and ETH are correlated; no pooled independent-sample claim.
evaluation.publicPredictionGate: No public model prediction. Require independent methodological review and a prospectively timestamped paper-forecast period before any public forecast.
